description: This file is a PHP web page responsible for configuring MoCA (Multimedia over Coax Alliance) network settings on a gateway device. It includes PHP code for initializing parameters, retrieving current configuration, and rendering an HTML form with embedded JavaScript for client-side interactions and form validation. The file also references external PHP includes for headers, utilities, navigation, and footer, as well as external scripts for handling user input and AJAX requests.
external_methods: // Note: Appears as a PHP function; assuming it's implemented elsewhere.

methods.name: init_psmMode
methods.description: Initializes page context or mode related to the MoCA configuration interface.

methods.name: KeyExtGet
methods.description: Retrieves current configuration parameters from the device, given a prefix and parameter list.

methods.name: getStr
methods.description: Retrieves a string value from device configuration or session.

methods.name: php_str_and
methods.description: Performs bitwise AND operation on two hexadecimal strings representing bit masks.
